INSERT INTO inquiry ( inquiry_no, member_no, category, title, content, secret_yn, status, created_at, delete_yn ) VALUES ( #{inquiryNo}, #{memberNo}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{secretYn}, '답변대기', SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, i.member_no AS memberNo, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, i.category, i.title, i.content, i.secret_yn AS secretYn, i.status, i.view_count AS viewCount, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.updated_at AS updatedAt, i.delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry i JOIN member m ON i.member_no = m.member_no WHERE i.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT i.inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, i.member_no AS memberNo, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, i.category, i.title, i.content, i.secret_yn AS secretYn, i.status, i.view_count AS viewCount, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.updated_at AS updatedAt, i.delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry i JOIN member m ON i.member_no = m.member_no WHERE i.inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo} AND i.delete_yn = 'N'

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}
